hero.sub: A stain on the ceiling, a water bill that jumped or the sound of water running when everything is off. We locate the leak, fix it and tell you honestly if old pipe needs replacing. Our office is on York Street, downtown.

blocks.intro: About half of Elmhurst's homes were built before 1970.

items.body: Threaded joints rust and leak first.
Decades of repairs leave copper joined to steel, which can corrode.
A detector under the water heater or sink alerts you early. If a pipe has burst, see [burst pipe repair](/elmhurst/burst-pipe-repair).

blocks.h2: What Happens When You Call J. Blanton
blocks.intro: Locate first, then open as little as possible.

img.alt: J. Blanton plumber in shoe covers on a home's front steps with a sewer camera

blocks.body: A small leak under a sink or behind the washer can go unnoticed for weeks. Battery-powered leak sensors placed near the water heater, washer, dishwasher and sinks alert your phone when they get wet. An automatic shutoff valve on the main line goes further: it closes the water when a leak is detected. For a finished basement, it's inexpensive protection.

blocks.h2: What Affects the Price of a Leak Repair
blocks.body: Finding the leak is often the bigger part of the job. A leak under a sink is fast. One inside a finished wall or under a floor takes testing to locate and more work to reach. The pipe material and how much of it is failing matter too. We locate the leak, explain the options and quote a flat price.

items.q: Can you install a water leak detector?
items.answer: Yes. We install leak detectors and automatic shutoff valves that alert you or shut off the water when a leak starts.

items.q: Do I need to repipe my house?
items.answer: Not always. One leak can be repaired. If galvanized pipe is failing throughout, repiping is the long-term fix.

items.q: How do you find a hidden leak?
items.preview: Listening tools, moisture meters and pressure tests.
items.answer: We narrow it down with listening equipment, moisture meters and pressure tests before opening anything.

items.preview: Sudden damage often, slow leaks often not.
items.answer: Policies vary. Check with your agent.

items.q: Can a shutoff valve be added to my main line?
items.answer: Yes. We install automatic shutoff valves on the main water line.

items.preview: A tiny hole in a copper pipe.
items.answer: A tiny hole that forms in copper pipe over time. It can drip slowly for months inside a wall.

items.q: How much does leak repair cost in Elmhurst?
items.preview: It depends on the leak. You'll approve a flat price first.
items.answer: It depends on where the leak is and how we reach it. You'll approve a flat-rate price before we start.
